description: This file defines a PHP class named 'CurrentAndChangeEntitlement' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dto'. The class encapsulates two arrays representing current and change-related leave entitlements, with getter and setter methods for each. It is part of the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically handling data transfer for leave entitlements.

classes.name: CurrentAndChangeEntitlement
classes.description: A data transfer object representing current and change leave entitlements, providing methods to access and modify the entitlement data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing current and change entitlements with optional array parameters.

methods.name: getCurrent
methods.description: Returns the array of current entitlements.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the array of current entitlements.

methods.name: getChange
methods.description: Returns the array of change entitlements.

methods.name: setChange
methods.description: Sets the array of change entitlements.
